verified_facts.text: Hotel Zeppelin is at 545 Post Street, close to Union Square, Maiden Lane and Chinatown.
verified_facts.excerpt: what’s around our 545 Post Street address—think Union Square, Maiden Lane, and Chinatown to name a few

verified_facts.text: The hotel is two blocks from Union Square.
Hotel Zeppelin is the sister hotel to San Francisco's Hotel Zetta.
verified_facts.excerpt: The groovier sister to San Francisco’s Hotel Zetta

verified_facts.text: The hotel opened in early March 2016.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Hotel Zeppelin opened in early March of 2016

verified_facts.text: Rooms have eclectic amenities such as vintage record players and crushed velvet pillows on the beds that recall the city's counterculture roots.
verified_facts.excerpt: the 196-room hotel celebrates the city with eclectic amenities—think vintage record players and crushed velvet pillows on the beds—that recall its counter culture roots

verified_facts.text: Bathrooms feature psychedelic wallpaper bearing the names of local bands, from the Grateful Dead to Green Day, in homage to '60s and '70s rock posters.
verified_facts.excerpt: the bathrooms are emblazoned with the names of local bands, from the Grateful Dead to Green Day, in a psychedelic wallpaper that pays homage to the classic rock posters of the ‘60s and ‘70s

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a game room with skeeball, shuffleboard and bingo.
verified_facts.excerpt: There's also an epic game room, where you can play a few rounds of skeeball, shuffleboard, bingo, and more.

verified_facts.text: The hotel describes itself as a love letter to rebels and revolutionaries, with free-spirited, artistic and rock 'n' roll character.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hotel Zeppelin is a change-up from the expected—a fusion of free-spirited energy, artistic soul, and rock ‘n’ roll edge.

verified_facts.text: The PLS on Post bar serves retro-chic cocktails, craft brews and sangria, with a daily happy hour.
verified_facts.excerpt: Retro-chic cocktails, craft brews and sangria flow daily from 3–6 pm.

verified_facts.text: On-site dining serves coffee pick-me-ups as well as burgers and shakes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Caffeine-infused pick-me-ups or a full-spread of burgers and shakes

verified_facts.text: The Game Room can host social events and receptions.
verified_facts.excerpt: Host an unforgettable social event at Hotel Zeppelin, whether you're planning a lively reception for friends, colleagues, or a special celebration. Let the good times roll in our Game Room
Throw the rulebook out the window and finally feel free enough to innovate.

verified_facts.text: Hotel Zeppelin was named in the Conde Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards in 2018, 2019, 2021 and 2025.
